name: Daniel Han
bio: Daniel Han is a co-founder of Unsloth, which builds tools for fine-tuning, compressing, and running open models locally. They previously worked at NVIDIA on GPU-accelerated machine learning in the RAPIDS ecosystem. They have reported and fixed bugs in several open models and maintain the HyperLearn library.
known_for: Co-founding Unsloth and its Triton training kernels
Bug fixes in Gemma, Llama, Mistral, and Phi implementations
